title: Standard Quantum Phase Estimation Detects All Eigenvalues via Randomized Initial States
summary: Standard quantum phase estimation (QPE) has often been regarded as unsuitable for simultaneous detection of all eigenvalues, because it requires initial states with sufficient overlap with the target eigenstates. In this paper, we show that this limitation is not inherent to the QPE circuit itself. The output distribution of standard QPE can be written as a superposition of Fejér kernels weighted by the squared overlaps with the eigenmodes.
